# Event catalogue

Every fact the system records is one of these payloads, appended to the event store (`src/store/`) inside an envelope `{seq, ts_utc, ist_date, type, schema_version, decision_id, cycle_id, book_id, symbol, source, payload}`. Projections (orders, fills, positions, trades, decisions, ...) are pure functions of these events. 46 types; the stream topic is where the web console receives it.

| Type | Version | Topic | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [AdvisorFallback](#advisorfallback) | 1 | decisions | The advisor could not answer; the deterministic decision stands (``SYS_LLM_DEGRADED``). |
| [AdvisorRequested](#advisorrequested) | 1 | decisions | - |
| [AdvisorVerdict](#advisorverdict) | 1 | decisions | A per-book advisor's veto/approve on one proposal (AI invariants: §2 of the plan). |
| [Alert](#alert) | 1 | system | - |
| [AnnouncementCoverageGap](#announcementcoveragegap) | 1 | market | Announcements between ``gap_from`` and ``gap_to`` may have been missed (feed outage, or more announcements than the feed window holds). Downstream gates treat it as unknown. |
| [AnnouncementReceived](#announcementreceived) | 1 | market | A corporate announcement for a universe instrument (plan M7.6), point in time: the exchange's ``published_at`` and our ``received_at`` (what a replay may know, and when). |
| [BarClosed](#barclosed) | 1 | market | - |
